newsitem.title: USA: Response to acquire monitoring accounts.
newsitem.headline: Response to acquire monitoring accounts.

text.p: Response USA Inc said on Monday it executed a letter of intent to buy approximately 2,100 residential and commercial alarm monitoring accounts from a New Jersey based alarm company.

The acquisition, along with the pending acquisition of approximately 2,000 alarm monitoring accounts, will bring the total number of accounts monitored by the company to approximately 51,000 and increase its monthly recurring revenue by in excess of $50,000 to approximately $950,000.
A spokesman for Response USA said company procedure limited further details from being divulged at this time.

Response USA is engaged in the acquisition of monitoring accounts from independent dealers, the marketing of residential and commercial security systems and providing monitoring services to residential and commercial alarm customers.
